title: S3 backend: skip_s3_checksum does not disable aws-chunked content-encoding on PutObject
body:
## Description

When using the S3 backend with a non-AWS S3-compatible object storage (e.g., IBM Cleversafe/COS), `PutObject` requests fail with `403 AccessDenied` even though `skip_s3_checksum = true` is set in the backend configuration.

The root cause is that `skip_s3_checksum` does not disable the AWS SDK v2's chunked transfer encoding and checksum trailer on `PutObject` requests. The SDK still sends:

```
content-encoding: aws-chunked
x-amz-content-sha256: STREAMING-UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD-TRAILER
